 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Now on a two-game losing streak, both coming from a 20-or-more-point deficit, Northwestern (3-2) travels to South Carolina for the Charleston Classic. On Friday, the 'Cats face the Virginia Tech Hokies (5-0), who are off to a hot start on the season and averaging 88.8 points per game (49th nationally) with a +8.8 turnover margin (fifth nationally). 
 Here's everything you need to know for this afternoon. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Broadcast Information
 Location: TD Arena (Charleston, South Carolina)
 Tip-off: 2:00 p.m. CT
 TV/Streaming: ESPN2
 Radio :
 WGN Radio 720
 Betting Line
 Northwestern -10.5, O/U 142.5 (via BetMGM)
 Injury Report 
 Neither team has released an official injury report online ahead of Friday's game.
